summary: Iteration 63 — verified expanded Catholic World Map (78 sites / 55 countries, idempotent) + new Vocation guide feature end-to-end. Backend (10/10 pytest passing): GET /api/sites returns 78 items across 55 countries with full schema (site_id, name, lat, lng, type, relics[], saints[], miracles[], history, source_url); seed is idempotent across repeat calls. GET /api/vocation/guide returns has_vocation=true with label, intro, morning_prayer{title,body}, companions[]{slug,name,why,prayer}, ideas[], traditions[], companion_saint, state; with vocation='' returns has_vocation=false. Traditions correctly DIFFER between state=discerning and state=living for the same vocation (marriage). Spanish (Accept-Language: es) and Italian (it) return translated prayer/ideas/traditions via the shared translation cache (first call cold via LLM, then cached). PUT /api/preferences round-trip preserves marital_status, vocation, vocation_state, dietary, and companion_saint — verified by GET after merging companion_saint into existing prefs. Frontend (mobile 390x844, authed via localStorage sanctus_session_token=test_feat_aug25): Home tab shows the vocation-home-card with 'HOLY MARRIAGE', 'Morning Prayer for the Family' and 'Walking with St. Joseph — Tap for prayers, ideas & traditions to grow →'. Tapping it routes to /vocation; the vocation-screen renders vocation-prayer (Morning Prayer for the Family body), the companion list, vocation-ideas, and the nested vocation-traditions box. Tapping vocation-companion-st-joseph selects it (checkmark + its prayer surfaces) and persists (re-render of Home card afterwards still reads 'Walking with St. Joseph'; GET /api/preferences confirms companion_saint='st-joseph'). Profile → 'Your Walk with Christ': pref-vstate-discerning and pref-vstate-living toggles are both present, tapping each updates GET /api/preferences accordingly (vocation_state=discerning → living). Catholic World Map (/community/map) renders the 78-site list ('Explore 78 significant Catholic places across the world.'); map-toggle-list works; tapping map-list-yamoussoukro opens the detail sheet showing 'Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, Yamoussoukro, Ivory Coast · 1985–1989' with the full history + Learn more + Close. Test account RESET to vocation=marriage, state=living, companion_saint=st-joseph, marital_status=single before finishing.

critical_code_review_comments: vocations.py: state defaults to 'living' on the server when the prefs field is missing — matches frontend default and prevents 500s for legacy users.
vocations.py: _localize keeps a deep copy via _build_guide so module-level CONTENT is never mutated by per-request translation. ✔
catholic_sites.py: _seed_if_missing checks by slug before insert — verified idempotent (two back-to-back GET /api/sites both returned total=78).
catholic_sites.py: _public excludes Mongo _id ✔. Localization fans out via the shared translation cache so first es/it list call is slow but subsequent calls are instant.

Frontend Vocation screen merges existing prefs before PUT when persisting companion_saint — verified backend round-trip preserves all other preference fields (marital_status / vocation / vocation_state / dietary).
